title: Repair of an Elongated Fan Cowl Door Hinge Land by Bush Installation
abstract: Repair of an elongated fan cowl door hinge land by reaming and installing a bush, used when the measured elongation is inside the limit for a bushed repair and the cowl does not need replacement.

sections.purpose: This task repairs a fan cowl door hinge land that has elongated in service, by reaming the land and installing an interference fit bush, and restores the hinge pin diameter to nominal.
sections.job_setup_note: The cowl must be removed from the aircraft and supported on a trestle. Measure the elongation in two axes before you decide the repair: a land that is elongated beyond the limit in the instructions cannot be bushed and the cowl must be replaced. The reaming is done in one operation with the pilot in the adjacent land, so the two lands must be checked for alignment before you start.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the cowl from the nacelle and put it on the trestle. WARNING: THE FAN COWL DOOR IS AWKWARD AND HEAVY. TWO PERSONS ARE REQUIRED FOR THE REMOVAL AND THE TRESTLE MUST BE SECURED BEFORE THE COWL IS RELEASED. 2. Remove the paint from the hinge land and from a 30 millimetre band around it. 3. Measure the land bore in two axes at right angles and record both readings. 4. Compare the larger reading with the limit in the instructions and stop if it is exceeded. 5. Check the alignment of the two adjacent lands with the alignment bar. CAUTION: DO NOT REAM A LAND WHOSE NEIGHBOUR IS OUT OF ALIGNMENT. THE BUSH WILL BE INSTALLED SKEWED AND THE HINGE PIN WILL BIND. 6. Ream the land to the bush interference size using the pilot in the adjacent land. 7. Clean the bore and do a dye penetrant inspection; a crack indication makes the repair invalid. 8. Chill the bush and install it in one movement, fully seated. 9. Allow the bush to reach ambient temperature and check the bore diameter against nominal. 10. Apply the protection scheme to all bare material. 11. Install the mount link D7110112111633 with the bolts AES484712-68 and torque them in sequence. 12. Refit the seal IB779874-66 and the corner bracket NY814392-02 if they were disturbed. 13. Re-hang the cowl, check the nozzle clearance at FIN 71EN against drawing D71101167094 and do a full open and close cycle.
sections.close_out: Record both bore readings, the bush part reference and the final bore diameter on the repair record. Restore the paint scheme over the repaired area. Report the repair to engineering so that the cowl history is maintained; a cowl may not carry more than the number of bushed lands given in the instructions.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The bushed land is standard post MOD-154688 and this repair restores it.

safety_precautions: Two persons are required to remove the cowl.
Secure the trestle before the cowl is released.
Stop the repair if a crack indication is found.

tooling.reference: Hinge land reamer and pilot set

title: Repair of an Elongated Fan Cowl Door Hinge Land by Bush Installation

issue.reason: The bushed land limit is quoted with its source in the hinge bracket bulletin and the mixed standard of a repaired cowl is stated in the job set-up.

abstract: Repair of an elongated fan cowl door hinge land by reaming and bush installation, with the limit on how many lands of one cowl may be bushed and the standard that a part-repaired cowl is then at.

sections.purpose: This task repairs a fan cowl door hinge land that has elongated in service, by reaming the land and installing an interference fit bush, and restores the hinge pin diameter to nominal.
sections.job_setup_note: The cowl must be removed from the aircraft and supported on a trestle. The reaming is done in one operation with the pilot in the adjacent land, so the two lands must be checked for alignment before you start. Understand what the repair leaves behind. A cowl repaired at one land is at the modified bushed standard at that land and at the original standard at every other, and that mixed condition is what the hinge pin sees. Two bushed lands on one hinge line is the maximum, the same limit that governs the hinge bracket bulletin ZPH-71-1013; a cowl already at the limit is replaced rather than repaired again.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the cowl from the nacelle and put it on the trestle. WARNING: THE FAN COWL DOOR IS AWKWARD AND HEAVY. TWO PERSONS ARE REQUIRED FOR THE REMOVAL AND THE TRESTLE MUST BE SECURED BEFORE THE COWL IS RELEASED. 2. Remove the paint from the hinge land and from a 30 millimetre band around it. 3. Measure the land bore in two axes at right angles and record both readings. 4. Compare the larger reading with the limit in the instructions and stop if it is exceeded. 5. Check the alignment of the two adjacent lands with the alignment bar. CAUTION: DO NOT REAM A LAND WHOSE NEIGHBOUR IS OUT OF ALIGNMENT. THE BUSH WILL BE INSTALLED SKEWED AND THE HINGE PIN WILL BIND. 6. Ream the land to the bush interference size using the pilot in the adjacent land. 7. Clean the bore and do a dye penetrant inspection; a crack indication makes the repair invalid. 8. Chill the bush and install it in one movement, fully seated. 9. Allow the bush to reach ambient temperature and check the bore diameter against nominal. 10. Apply the protection scheme to all bare material. 11. Install the mount link D7110112111633 with the bolts AES484712-68 and torque them in sequence. 12. Refit the seal IB779874-66 and the corner bracket NY814392-02 if they were disturbed. 13. Re-hang the cowl, check the nozzle clearance at FIN 71EN against drawing D71101167094 and do a full open and close cycle.
sections.close_out: Record both bore readings, the bush part reference and the final bore diameter on the repair record. Restore the paint scheme over the repaired area. Report the repair to engineering so that the cowl history is maintained, and enter the running count of bushed lands for that cowl. No cowl may carry more than two bushed lands on one hinge line; the limit is set by the hinge bracket bulletin ZPH-71-1013 and is repeated here so that a repair station reading only this task cannot exceed it.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The bushed land is standard post MOD-154688 and this repair restores it, up to the two-land limit stated in the hinge bracket bulletin.

safety_precautions: Two persons are required to remove the cowl.
Secure the trestle before the cowl is released.
Stop the repair if a crack indication is found.

tooling.reference: Hinge land reamer and pilot set
